name: Google Shape;96;p14
text: Track 03: Commodity Derivatives Intelligence

name: Google Shape;97;p14
text:
Problem: GOLDM, GOLDTEN, GOLDGUINEA and GOLDPETAL represent gold, but lot size, quotation base, purity and expiry differ.
Impact: a visible price gap may reflect contract mechanics, maturity or delivery basis. Fees and thin trading can erase an apparent advantage.
Research challenge: compare normalized exact contracts, separate curve movement from roll-down, and replay decisions without future information.
Responsible output: account for costs, contract calendars and gold exposure. Suppress unsupported signals and report when evidence is insufficient.

Source: user-supplied Track 03 challenge brief. Official references: https://www.mcxindia.com/market-data/bhavcopy and https://www.mcxindia.com/products/bullion/gold. The product page was opened on 15 October 2026. The Bhavcopy page could not be fetched by the research tool. This deck does not independently verify all specification values or imply real-time data access. GOLDTEN history starts in its listing period. Volume is not market depth, and settlement is not an executable fill.

name: Google Shape;103;p15
text: SOLUTION

name: Google Shape;105;p15
text:
Relative Value Explorer: six-pair scan, exact-expiry unit/purity normalization, Z/MAD deviations and maturity adjustment.
Futures Curve Laboratory: curve shape, calendar spreads, empirical carry, roll-down and residual shift.
Ghost Market: joint bootstrap across 11 stress classes with fixed seeds, tail summaries and cost sensitivity.
Market Red Team: 21 executable checks for leakage, fills, costs, contract rules and evidence quality.

name: Google Shape;106;p15
text:
Time-Locked Replay: session clock, delayed Open fills, integer lots, walk-forward/frozen holdout, equity/P&L and gold exposure.
Profit Survival Map: cost/delay grids, holding, exit, slippage and liquidity slices, plus conditional break-even.
Anomaly DNA: 11-feature prior analogs, robust scaling and non-overlapping completed outcomes.
Seven analytical workspaces supported by a shared contract and evidence engine

Sources: README.md, docs/methodology.md and frontend/app.py. All seven named analytical tools have executable functions. Quotes normalize to INR per fine gram, with a common 10g 999 representation. Exact expiry selection prevents artificial continuous-contract rolls. Curve interpolation requires bracketing maturities and does not extrapolate. Replay uses subsequent common-session Open, never substitutes Close, preserves unresolved exits and uses prior-volume participation limits. It separates completed-trade P&L, open marks and equity. The gold factor contribution and relative-value residual are an accounting decomposition, not causal alpha attribution. Scenario and analog summaries are descriptive, not calibrated investment probabilities.

Relative Value Explorer implemented feature detail:
- GOLDM, GOLDTEN, GOLDGUINEA and GOLDPETAL; all six cross-product combinations.
- Explicit expiry selection or one fixed exact contract per leg selected within cutoff; no stitched near-month series.
- Raw quotation spread, quotation-unit normalization, purity adjustment and INR-per-fine-gram comparison.
- Supported empirical maturity adjustment using bracketing same-product curves; no extrapolation.
- Rolling references, mean/std Z-score and robust median/MAD Z-score fitted to strictly prior observations.
- Volume/OI, lifecycle, geographic-basis and specification flags; current candidate/no-opportunity conclusion.
- Normalized-series charts, selectable measures, calculated records and CSV export.

Futures Curve Laboratory implemented feature detail:
- Historical cutoff curve for the first selected product; full investigations also calculate both products' curves.
- Exact maturities, days to expiry and normalized prices.
- Calendar spreads, maturity gaps, daily curve slope and annualized curve ratio.
- Contango, backwardation, flat, mixed or insufficient-curve classification.
- Unchanged-contract movement decomposed into modeled mechanical roll-down and residual curve shift.
- Piecewise-linear interpolation only; unresolved funding/storage/delivery factors remain explicit.

Ghost Market implemented feature detail:
- Seeded circular moving-block bootstrap jointly samples paired returns to retain cross-leg and within-block dependence.
- Integer lots, contract monetary multipliers, gross notional and residual fine-gold exposure.
- Eleven base/adverse scenario classes with lifecycle/liquidity eligibility.
- Median, mean, worst, fifth/ninety-fifth percentiles, positive scenario frequency and expected shortfall at 5% (requires at least 200 simulations).
- Scenario distributions display up to 100 sampled outcomes; summary statistics use every configured path.
- Historical return correlation, cost sensitivity and fragile/survives-modeled-medians indicator.
- Adjustable random seed, path count, holding period, delay, costs/slippage and volatility multiplier.
- Future fee assumptions freeze the cutoff-date schedule as a turnover-equivalent rate; no calibrated real-profit odds.

Market Red Team implemented feature detail:
- Each check records attack ID, invariant, source evidence, procedure, status, severity and explanation.
- Twenty-one checks cover dates, purity, quotation units, integer lots, expiry identity, roll contamination, future leakage, delayed fills, actual source Opens, lifecycle, costs, P&L/attribution, liquidity, local research logging, holdout retuning, sample confidence, neutrality, sample size, geography, imputation and mode separation.
- Future-mutation audit compares cutoff-limited results; clearly labeled temporary probes are used only when needed, with a relaxed-cutoff positive control.
- Temporary probe rows never become market observations or research returns.
- Independent source-rejoining, cost reconstruction, lot/P&L reconciliation and lifecycle rechecks.
- Untested or unresolved checks never count as passes; audit failures reject the investigation.

Time-Locked Replay implemented feature detail:
- Load observed sessions, reveal one session per step, reset clock and view reveal progress.
- Each UI step requests a new strict information cutoff; stale configuration invalidates the displayed replay.
- Automatic expiry choice frozen from the first research session.
- Close-based signals enter at later common-session Open; configurable holding period and entry/exit delays.
- No Close/settlement substitution for missing Open; missing exit remains an open marked position.
- Integer sizing constrained by combined fully funded gross notional, max lots and prior signal-session volume.
- Lifecycle/specification changes, listing/tender/expiry and liquidity screens block invalid entries/fills.
- Walk-forward thresholds fit prior absolute Z-scores; frozen final-period threshold and stable calendar boundary.
- Chronological signal, suppression, rejection, entry and exit events; training windows and exact trade records.
- Equity, realized/unrealized P&L, all-leg entry/exit costs, drawdown, return on capital, volatility, descriptive Sharpe and win rate.
- Gold-factor contribution, relative-value accounting residual and quantified residual fine-metal exposure.
- Held-out trade count/net P&L, training/snapshot hashes and reference baselines.
- Reference comparisons: cash/no-trade, exact-expiry gold buy-and-hold mark and fixed long/short integer hedge mark; marked benchmarks do not establish actual final liquidation.

Profit Survival Map implemented feature detail:
- Recomputes actual chronological replay for each cost/entry-delay grid cell, including integer quantities and cash flows.
- Heatmap, trade count, gross/net P&L, drawdown and evaluated/not-evaluable flags.
- Separate sensitivity slices for additional exit delay, slippage, minimum volume and holding period.
- Volatility, liquidity, expiry-restriction and combined-stress summaries kept distinct from historical replay.
- Highest tested profitable cost boundary for each delay.
- Conditional total, fee and slippage break-even rates derived from zero-fee trade turnover.
- Survival requires resolved positions, completed trades, positive completed net P&L, positive total equity change and lifecycle validity.

Anomaly DNA implemented feature detail:
- Same exact-contract-pair search using 11 interpretable features.
- Features: Z-score, robust Z-score, spread change, gold volatility, log volume, log OI, residual volatility, trend, persistence, time to expiry and maturity gap.
- Robust median/MAD scaler fitted only to completed prior candidates, with standard-deviation fallback.
- Distance-ranked historical matches; overlapping outcome horizons suppressed.
- Every analog outcome completes strictly before the query cutoff.
- Matched dates, feature vectors, similarity distance, lifecycle flag and signed residual outcome.
- Sample count, median residual change and narrowing frequency; explicitly descriptive rather than profit prediction.

name: Google Shape;112;p16
text: ARCHITECTURE

name: Google Shape;114;p16
text:
Data Management: CSV, TSV, XLS/XLSX and ZIP ingestion, explicit dates, requested-date checks, duplicate handling, raw hashes and isolated synthetic data.
Contract Genome: versioned quotation, purity, lot and location rules, exact expiry identities, integer hedge sizing and listing/tender/expiry eligibility.
Settings: explicit cost schedules, slippage, capital, liquidity, replay and simulation controls. Session persistence and stale-result detection.
Command Center + Mirage Investigation: coverage dashboard, full pipeline, A/B/C comparisons, candidates, curve adjustments and rejection reasons.
Evidence Center: SQLite experiment ledger, preserved Parquet snapshots, JSON/CSV exports and deterministic reproduction with data, specification and code checks.

name: Google Shape;115;p16
text:
Streamlit + Plotly interface   /   FastAPI + Pydantic API
DuckDB + Parquet market data   /   SQLite ledger   /   No paid API or required LLM

Sources: README.md, docs/methodology.md, docs/validation.md, frontend/app.py and backend/main.py. Data import validates MDY/DMY, expiry strings and padded symbols, rejects annual aggregates, missing/invalid fields, unsafe ZIP paths and excessive expansion. Duplicate/conflicting identities remain inspectable. Real and synthetic data stay separate. The Contract Genome distinguishes quotation and trading units, purity, delivery geography and expiry-effective rules. Unknown real calendar evidence blocks execution. Settings include dated fee schedules/GST/tax assumptions, slippage, delays, capital, seeds, paths and API timeout. Policy A uses normalized spreads, B adds supported maturity adjustment, C adds robust-MAD, lifecycle, basis and prospective bootstrap gates. Command Center and Mirage preserve full investigations. Evidence Center stores failed and successful experiments, flags repeated sample use and refuses changed snapshots/specifications/code during reproduction. Matching hashes establish deterministic reproduction, not an externally secured ledger. Local single-worker FastAPI avoids cross-process DuckDB contention. Docker files exist but Docker execution remains unverified. TSV is supported by the backend. The UI picker exposes CSV, XLS/XLSX and ZIP. Replay uses a prior-volume participation limit with a 1% default.

Command Center implemented feature detail:
- Imported-observation and exact-contract counts; first and last observed sessions.
- Selected pair, research dates, cutoff, costs, slippage and seed summary.
- One-click integrated investigation with preserved certificate.
- Available exact-expiry contracts table and expandable dataset-quality metadata.
- Results surface verdict, execution feasibility, metrics, nested research outputs and complete backend assumptions.

Mirage Investigation implemented feature detail:
- Integrated pipeline: normalized residual analysis, both futures curves, prior analogs, chronological replay, Red Team, Ghost Market and survival analysis.
- Prospective full-policy gates for robust-score agreement, maturity/geographic/specification evidence, lifecycle, liquidity and stress medians.
- A/B/C policy comparison on the same contracts, dates, capital, liquidity and cost/execution assumptions.
- Typed stage results and stage-start/stage-completion/failure records.
- Explicit verdicts: REJECTED, INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE or SURVIVES MODELED TESTS; failed audits take precedence.
- Conservative evidence gates include all 11 stress classes, evaluated audits, 30 completed held-out trades, positive held-out net P&L, current candidate and no unresolved open position.
- Records rejected signals, no-opportunity conclusions and insufficient evidence as valid research outcomes.

Contract Genome implemented feature detail:
- Inspectable specification registry and observed exact contract identities/lifecycle coverage.
- Expiry-contract-effective versions distinguish simultaneously traded contracts.
- Four gold products with distinct lot size, quotation unit, purity and quote location.
- Normalization, lot value, fine grams per lot and specification provenance flags.
- Integer hedge minimizes residual fine-metal fraction within maximum lots and combined fully funded gross notional.
- Residual fine grams, residual fraction and exact-metal-neutral indicator.
- Lifecycle gating for verified spec, mode match, observation validity, listing date, tender start and expiry.
- Separate fictional synthetic registry; unverified real provenance/calendar evidence blocks execution claims.
- Real registry retains 12 reviewed official PDF versions plus four unverified baselines; original PDF byte hashes remain unavailable.

Evidence Center implemented feature detail:
- Mode-filtered investigation history, saved-result selection and inspection.
- JSON export of complete Evidence Certificate.
- Configuration, exact contracts/expiries, source files/hashes, data quality, specification snapshot and historical cutoff.
- Preserved canonical Parquet snapshot, seed, model version, code/specification/snapshot/result hashes.
- All stage outputs, verdict, execution-feasibility status, cost assumptions, limitations and local ledger.
- Request/planned-test/stage/conclusion/failure/reproduction history; count of prior similar experiments flags sample reuse.
- One-click deterministic reproduction returns matching/nonmatching result hashes.
- Reproduction refuses changed data snapshots, specification registries or engine code.
- Local reproducibility and tamper detection are supported; externally anchored tamper resistance is not claimed.

Data Management implemented feature detail:
- Batch upload CSV, XLS, XLSX and ZIP through the UI; backend also reads TSV and HTML tables disguised as XLS.
- Explicit MDY/DMY source-date convention; separate requested, returned, observation and expiry dates.
- Canonical OHLC/settlement/volume/OI/trading-value schema with source file, hash, timestamp, validity and mode.
- Header aliases; restrict to supported gold futures; unsupported instruments/products counted as skipped.
- Strict positive/finite price and OHLC checks; nonnegative integer liquidity; expiry/date validation.
- Missing observations/prices remain missing; no silent forward filling or inferred holidays.
- Exact duplicate handling, raw-file duplicate hashes and quarantine for conflicting records.
- Annual-report rejection with preserved source bytes, file hashes and rejection reports.
- DuckDB market-data source of truth and mode-specific Parquet snapshots.
- Browse by dates/product/row limit, inspect query metadata and export displayed CSV.
- Import/source-provenance history.
- Seeded isolated synthetic generator; separate mode selection and persistent synthetic banner.
- Bounded uploads, safe in-memory ZIP processing, traversal/symlink/encryption/nesting/expansion safeguards; no macros/scripts/formulas executed.

Settings implemented feature detail:
- All-in cost bps, separate slippage and volatility stress.
- Optional nonoverlapping effective-dated JSON fee schedules validated through the API.
- Per-lot brokerage, exchange/regulatory bps, buy/sell taxes, GST and extra per-lot charges; selected by fill date.
- Random seed, simulation paths and API request timeout.
- Research API address and health-connection check.
- Browser-session preference persistence.
- Sidebar controls: real/synthetic mode, products, exact expiries, dates/cutoff, historical window, A/B/C policy and Z threshold.
- Execution controls: capital, maximum lots, minimum volume/OI, holding period, entry delay and exit delay.
- Result/configuration matching invalidates stale results after assumptions change.
- No required LLM, paid API or collected model credentials.

name: Google Shape;123;p17
text:
Target users: commodity research desks, quantitative analysts and finance education teams that need reviewable contract-level research.
Value proposition: one local workflow connects normalization and curve analysis with adverse tests, costed replay and reproducible evidence.
Revenue hypotheses: team software licenses, research pilots and educational deployments. Pricing and willingness to pay need customer testing.
Market size and growth: no validated estimate or adoption forecast yet. Next steps are interviews, pilot usage and retention measurement.

name: Google Shape;124;p17
text: Customer, revenue and growth statements are hypotheses. The prototype has no documented commercial traction.

Target users and revenue models are product hypotheses based on the prototype capabilities. No customer interviews, market size, revenue, pricing validation, competitive benchmarks or measured commercial traction were supplied. Proposed next validation: interview researchers, observe workflow trials, measure repeat use and willingness to pay.

name: Google Shape;130;p18
text: FUTURE SCOPE

name: Google Shape;132;p18
text:
Authentic evaluation: ingest daily Bhavcopy history and verify listing/tender calendars, original specification hashes and dated fee sources.
Independent validation: review the methodology and expand untouched periods before making any real trading-performance claim.
Richer research: investigate cointegration, calibrated uncertainty and stronger attribution beyond the current accounting decomposition.
Execution assessment: improve liquidity and fill modeling while retaining explicit lifecycle and basis restrictions.
Long investigations: add persistent background jobs, progress tracking and cancellation. An optional LLM assistant remains future work.

name: Google Shape;133;p18
text: Current boundary: local research prototype. Brokerage/order routing and validated real-history performance are unavailable.

Sources: README.md Current limits and next work, docs/validation.md Status and remaining limitations. The roadmap items are not implemented claims. The application presently has no optional LLM integration, cointegration/error-correction model, calibrated predictive probabilities, causal alpha attribution, persistent cancellable job queue or order routing. Missing genuine daily observations and verified calendars block authentic historical evaluation.

name: Google Shape;139;p19
text: EXTRA: DEMO & VALIDATION

name: Google Shape;141;p19
text:
Working product: 13 workspaces with charts and CSV/JSON exports. A/B/C policy comparisons plus cash, gold buy-and-hold and fixed-hedge references.
Documented checks: 84 tests passed on 9 October 2026, covering ingestion, financial math, future-data leakage, replay, audit, reproduction and all pages.
Synthetic demo: 2,160 records across four products and 12 fictional expiry identities. Ghost Market ran 11 classes with 500 paths each.
Result: Policy C rejected 17 candidate sessions and made zero trades. Red Team reported 10 pass, 0 fail and 11 not evaluable. Reproduction hashes matched.
Honest verdict: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE. Five supplied annual reports contained zero daily observations. Real MCX trading performance remains unvalidated.
